title: Broken App Test
author: @lunokjod
description: Seven ways of breaking on purpose: a nil that is indexed, a global that is not a function, an error with a message of the app's own, one thrown as a table, a loop that never ends, a recursion with no end and a string that does not fit in the memory. Each button is a different why, and what the system paints is the page of the error —the message, the traceback and the way on—, which is what this app exists to show.
